answerBridgeId.description: A child reference within the current conversation parent lineage.

scope.description: Defaults to direct children. tree permits verified descendants.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring for list_channels/search, maximum 256 characters.

notifyConversationRefs.description: Optional same-tree C# references for a running-turn notice.

limit.description: Requested page size; output budget may reduce it. Default 20.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the same query.

conversationRef.description: Conversation reference C# returned by list_agents.

conversationRef.description: C# team member conversation; required for conversation view, optional for mailbox.

beforeMessageRef.description: Older-page cursor: M# for mailbox, R# for conversation history. Use the returned olderMessageRef.

messageRef.description: Optional reference of a single message to read in full: M# for mailbox, R# for conversation history.

offset.description: With messageRef: character offset of the page to read; use the returned nextOffset. Defaults to 0.

afterMessageRef.description: Optional M# cursor from the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum messages in a page; defaults to 20.

afterMessageRef.description: Optional M# cursor from the previous observation.

timeoutMs.description: Wait duration, at most 60 seconds; defaults to 30000.

question.description: The question shown to the user.

description.description: Optional explanation of the outcome or trade-off for this option.

options.description: The choices offered to the user. Each label must be unique within the question.

multiple.description: Enable multiple selection. Optional; defaults to false (single choice).

limit.description: Maximum conversations to return; defaults to 20.

conversationRef.description: Conversation reference C# returned by list_conversations.

beforeMessageRef.description: Optional R# cursor returned as olderMessageRef.

limit.description: Maximum messages in a page; defaults to 20.

messageRef.description: Optional R# reference of one transcript message to read in full, page by page; not combined with beforeMessageRef or limit.

offset.description: With messageRef: character offset of the page to read; use the returned nextOffset. Defaults to 0.

conversationRef.description: Conversation reference C# returned by list_conversations.

text.description: Message or task. State facts, context and the expected result clearly.

mode.description: followup requests work and a reply; message only informs.

replyToMessageRef.description: Optional M# collaboration message reference being answered.

prompt.description: Complete task for the new conversation, including context, constraints and the expected result.

title.description: Optional short title shown in the conversation list; defaults to the start of prompt.

conversationRef.description: Optional conversation reference C# returned by list_conversations; omit to fork this conversation.

paths.description: File or directory paths to delete. Always use an array, even for one path. Relative paths are resolved from the current work environment root; absolute paths are supported when allowed by tool policy or when they are inside an explicitly allowed local work environment root.

items.description: File or directory path to delete.

path.description: File path. Relative paths are resolved from the current work environment root; absolute paths are supported when allowed by tool policy or when they are inside an explicitly allowed local work environment root.

hunks.description: Ordered hunk blocks. This branch is mutually exclusive with insert and delete. Each hunk performs exact search/replace in this same file.

oldContent.description: Existing file text to find. Must be an exact non-empty substring of the current file at the time this hunk runs.

newContent.description: Replacement text exactly as it should appear in the final file. Use an empty string to remove the matched text.

replaceAll.description: Whether this hunk replaces every non-overlapping oldContent match. Defaults to false, replacing only the first match.

insert.description: Line insertion branch. Do not provide it together with hunks or delete.

line.description: 1-based line number before which to insert content. Use line N+1 to append after the last line.

content.description: Non-empty text to insert at the specified line position. May contain multiple lines separated by newlines.

delete.description: Line deletion branch. Do not provide it together with hunks or insert.

builtin:edit.description: Provide exactly one edit branch: non-empty hunks, insert, or delete. Do not combine branches.

path.description: The usual input: a local file path. Relative paths are resolved from the current work environment root; absolute paths are supported when allowed by tool policy or when they are inside an explicitly allowed local work environment root.

mode.description: Optional for path reads only. When omitted, recognized local PNG, JPEG, WebP, and PDF paths use "attachment"; all other paths use "text". Explicit "attachment" is supported only for those media paths.

startLine.description: Text path reads only. Optional 1-based start line (inclusive); omit it when not needed. A read longer than the per-read budget returns a leading slice instead of failing; compare the returned endLine with totalLines and continue from endLine + 1.

endLine.description: Text path reads only. Optional 1-based end line (inclusive); omit it when not needed.

items.description: Optional batch of 2-8 independent local text reads. Use this instead of path; omit it for a single-file read. Attachments are not supported in a batch.

startLine.description: Optional 1-based inclusive start line. A read longer than the per-read budget returns a leading slice instead of failing; compare the returned endLine with totalLines and continue from endLine + 1.

attachmentId.description: Rare optional input for a past user-supplied attachment. Use only an exact non-empty id shown in the LimCode managed attachment catalog. Omit this field for local path and batch reads; never send an empty or invented id.

pages.description: Managed TXT/PDF only. Optional "N" or "N-M" page range such as "1-4"; defaults to "1" and allows at most 4 consecutive pages. Omit for images and local path reads.

operation.description: Required. Explicitly select spawn, send, list, read, wait or interrupt_subtree. There is no default operation.

prompt.description: Required for spawn and send. Complete task or follow-up, including context, constraints and expected verification.

answerBridgeId.description: Required for send, read and interrupt_subtree. For wait, supply this or answerBridgeIds, never both.

answerBridgeIds.description: For wait only: 1 to 32 distinct existing child references. Mutually exclusive with answerBridgeId.

taskName.description: Required for spawn. Short responsibility label, such as "trace send failure"; the full task belongs in prompt.

forkTurns.description: For spawn only: "none" (default), "all", or a positive integer string such as "3". Copies committed completed turns, excluding current, interrupted and failed turns. Does not inherit execution ownership or authority.

interrupt.description: When continuing a child, true redirects its current work immediately; false or omitted queues the follow-up after its current turn.

agent.description: For spawn only. Selects the child Agent configuration.

type.description: The Agent type/configuration id to use, such as main, worker, or explore. The backend may create a temporary runtime mirror internally, but mirror ids are not valid types and should not be supplied here. Available types are appended to the tool description at runtime. Defaults to worker.

foregroundWaitMs.description: Optional for spawn/send. Foreground wait in milliseconds, default 0; the child keeps running after it expires.

scope.description: Read-only list/read/wait scope. Defaults to direct children; tree includes verified descendants.

status.description: Optional exact ChildExecution status filter for list. Idle describes an available child; its latest Turn outcome is a separate field.

limit.description: List/read maximum page items, default 32. Token budgets may return fewer items or a partial source.

cursor.description: For list/read: nextCursor continues, rereadCursor repeats a truncated page. Keep the same scope, filters and target; immutable source identity must match.

timeoutMs.description: For wait only. Observation timeout in milliseconds, default 0; no child state is changed.

scheduling.description: Tool-call scheduling mode. Defaults to parallel. Use serial when this task may interfere with other tool calls.

name.description: The skill name (its directory slug), taken from the available skills list.

plan.description: The complete plan body. Include steps, scope, validation, and any risks directly in this text.

mode.description: submit_plan always provides a complete replacement task list.

title.description: Task title. In update mode this is also used as the key to match existing tasks; prefer a short verb-object phrase.

description.description: Additional notes, acceptance criteria, or context for the task. Also shown as the current-activity line while the task is in progress.

status.description: Task status: pending, in_progress, completed, blocked, or cancelled.

delete.description: Only used in update mode. Set to true to delete the task with the same title.

items.description: Non-empty complete ordered execution task list. Titles must be unique.

taskList.description: Required non-empty complete ordered execution task list. mode must be "rewrite" and titles must be unique.

workEnvironmentId.description: Target work environment id. Use one of the work environment ids listed in the tool definition.

mode.description: rewrite = replace the full task list; update = apply incremental changes to the task list.

title.description: Task title. In update mode this is also used as the key to match existing tasks; prefer a short verb-object phrase.

description.description: Additional notes, acceptance criteria, or context for the task. Also shown as the current-activity line while the task is in progress.

status.description: Task status: pending, in_progress, completed, blocked, or cancelled.

delete.description: Only used in update mode. Set to true to delete the task with the same title.

items.description: Task entries. In rewrite mode this is the full list; in update mode these are the changed entries.

transfers.description: Array of transfer tasks. Must be an array, even when transferring a single file.

fromEnvironment.description: Source work environment id, or current for the currently active work environment.

fromPath.description: Source path, relative or absolute. Relative paths are resolved against the root/workdir of fromEnvironment; directories should end with / or \.

toEnvironment.description: Target work environment id, or current for the currently active work environment.

toPath.description: Target path, relative or absolute. Relative paths are resolved against the root/workdir of toEnvironment; a directory path refers to the target directory itself.

overwrite.description: Whether to overwrite when the target exists, defaults to false.

createDirs.description: Whether to automatically create the target parent directory / target directory, defaults to true.

verify.description: Verification mode. none = no verification; size = compare source/target file sizes (default).

path.description: File path. Relative paths are resolved from the current work environment root; absolute paths are supported when allowed by tool policy or when they are inside an explicitly allowed local work environment root.

content.description: Complete UTF-8 content to write to the file.
